# Camp Resource: Blood Transfusion Pump

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 13, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Mar 4, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_292da66e731a41db81b7a179a570c5ac~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Everyone needs a fresh supply of blood sometimes.

The Blood Transfusion Pump removes Rads from human players and gives Rads to ghoul players.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Blood Transfusion Pump__

Image Credit: Nerevar

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a670b1a8352e49269a988f056487e709~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_21e7521d9fae4968bef6f86d97cf451b~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Transfers Rads from Human players to Ghoul players

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop (TBA - this item is still on the PTS)

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Floor Decor

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Steel

**Holds**

Removes 300 Rads from Human Players

Gives 140 Rads to Ghoul Players

Gives 160 Health (HP) to Ghoul Players

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X atoms

Atom Shop - Bundle - X atoms

**Cooldown Period** 

15 minutes

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
